title: test: parallelize independent permission checks
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Runs independent catalog and generation requests concurrently in two permission integration tests.
- Preserves every assertion and leaves production behavior unchanged.
- Keeps aggregate request latency below the existing per-test 5-second budget on slower CI runners.

Tests: `npx vitest run test/model-permissions.test.ts` (20 passed); `npm run typecheck`; Biome check.

gist.headline: Permission checks race politely
gist.blurb: Two independent permission checks now run side by side in CI, like bees taking separate flowers. Every assertion stays put; the test suite just spends less time waiting around.
gist.summary: Parallelized independent catalog and generation requests in two model-permission integration tests while preserving all assertions and the existing 5-second per-test latency budget.
gist.impact: Contributors get faster, more reliable permission-test runs on slower CI runners without any production behavior changing.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden test bench represents parallel integration checks: Polli, wearing tiny engineer goggles, sends two glowing request envelopes along separate vine paths toward a catalog bookshelf and a retro generation terminal. Both paths meet beneath a small passing test sign, with code-plants and a subtle timer showing they finish together.
